dictName: Hemacandra, Abhidhānacintāmaṇi (No. 6 of the Abhidhānasaṃgraha collection)

edition.label: Abhidhānasaṃgraha: a collection of Sanskrit ancient lexicons, No. 6-11, edited by Paṇḍit Śivadatta and Kāśīnāth Pāṇḍuraṅg Parab; the scanned volume carries No. 6, Hemacandra's Abhidhānacintāmaṇi
edition.evidence: The English title page (scan f01) and the Devanagari title page (scan f03) both give the editors, the Nirṇaya-sāgara Press and the year 1896, matching csl-orig/v02/abch/abchheader.xml (Hemacandra, Abhidhānacintāmaṇi, Bombay, The Nirṇaya-sāgara press, 1896, 58 p.) and the abch.txt metadata block (editors Paṇdit Śivadatta and Kāśīnāth Pāṇḍuraṅg Parab, publisher The Nirṇaya-sāgara press, Bombay, 1896 A.D.). The abch.txt credits record that the scanned book came from Acharya Shri Kailasasagarasuri Gyanamandir (kobatirth.org) and that Google OCR supplied the raw data, which is why every scan carries a 'Digitized by Google' watermark.

scanSets.description: Cologne ABCH page PDFs: the f series f01-f14 - f01 the English title page, f02 the registration notice, f03 the Devanagari title page, f04 a blank leaf, f05-f10 the six-page introduction on Hemacandra (the first page unnumbered, then printed 2-6, closing with the collection's works list and the editors' signature), f11 the kosa's division title with its opening verses 1-3 (printed page 1), f12-f14 printed pages 2-4 of the kosa - and the numbered series pg05-pg58 (printed pages 5-58). Printed pages 1-4 sit in the f series, so the numbered series begins at pg05 and pg01-pg04 do not exist. The volume is a Google-digitized copy and every page carries a 'Digitized by Google' watermark.

title.english: Introduction on Hemacandra's date and the Chaulukya kings, running head 'Hemacandrah'; six pages, the first unnumbered and the rest printed 2-6, closing with the collection's works list and the editors' signature

decodes.target: the chronology behind the author's floruit
decodes.mechanism: the introduction fixes Hemacandra's date by synchronising the Hemakumāracarita's account of his death with Kumārapāla's reign, and gives each Chaulukya king's reign in Vaṃśa-saṃvat years in the footnotes.

components.evidence: Scans f05-f10 read 25-09-2026 (verifier round 2) and re-anchored 10-10-2026 (H6411 rework): an unpaginated-first Sanskrit introduction under the running head 'Hemacandrah', establishing Hemacandra's date from the Hemakumaracarita and the Prabandhakosa, with the genealogy verses of the Caulukya kings and their Vamsa dates in the footnotes. The first page (f05) carries no printed number; f06-f10 are printed 2-6 (number bands read on f06 '२', f10 '६'); the final page f10 carries the collection's works list ('८. Abhidhanacintamanisilonchhah', '९. Linganusasanam') and closes with the editors' signature 'Pandita-Sivadatta-Kasinathah'. H5325's fill had placed this introduction at f07-f11 as five unnumbered pages, missing the registration leaf (f02), the blank leaf (f04) and the kosa's own opening page (f11).
components.notes: The introduction's first page carries no printed number and pages 2-6 are printed 2-6; the volume's own pagination continues with the kosa itself from printed page 1 on f11.

title.english: Closing colophon: 'Thus ends the Abhidhānacintāmaṇi composed by Śrī Hemacandrācārya'

components.evidence: Scan pg58 read 25-09-2026 (verifier round 2) and re-read 10-10-2026 (H6411 rework): the volume's last page (printed 58), head 'Abhidhanasamgrahah-6 Abhidhanacintamanih', carrying the final verses (to 9542) and the closing colophon 'iti Srimadhemacandracaryavirabito'bhidhanacintamanih samaptah || 6 ||' at the foot. The sixth kanda (Samanyakandah) opens at printed page 57 (pg57's head '६ Samanyakandah') and this colophon closes it with the work at printed page 58; H5325's claim that the same colophon closes the kanda at printed page 57 was wrong, and the verse count H5325 recorded as 'to 1542' drops the leading 9.
components.notes: The colophon is printed at the foot of the last text page, not on a separate leaf.

excludedScans.reason: A blank leaf in the front matter (between the Devanagari title page f03 and the introduction).

Printed page 1 of the kosa (division title 'Abhidhanasamgrahah-(छ) Abhidhanacintamanih' with the opening verses 1-3). Body text, scanned in the f series because the dictionary's own page refs begin at printed page 5.

Printed page 2 of the kośa (head 'अभिधानसंग्रहः—६ अभिधानचिन्तामणिः', verses 4-9 with the commentary). Body text, scanned in the f series because the dictionary's own page refs begin at printed page 5.
Printed page 3 of the kośa (head '१ देवाधिदेवकाण्डः', verses 10-15 with the commentary). Body text, same reason.
Printed page 4 of the kośa (head 'अभिधानसंग्रहः—६ अभिधानचिन्तामणिः', verses 16-23 with the commentary). Body text, same reason.

notes: The scan set is a Google-digitized copy from Acharya Shri Kailasasagari Gyanamandir (kobatirth.org): every page carries a 'Digitized by Google' watermark, and the f-series mixes true front matter with the kosa's printed pages 1-4. The volume is item No. 6 of the six-work 'Abhidhanasamgraha' collection named on both title pages, but it carries only the Abhidhanacintamani: the kosa's own pagination runs 1-58 (printed pages 1-4 in the f series, 5-58 in the numbered series) and its kandas are 1 Devadhidevakandah (printed page 1), 2 Devakandah (opens printed page 7) and, at the end, 6 Samanyakandah (opening at printed page 57 and closing with the work's colophon at printed page 58). The dictionary's digitized text in csl-orig/v02/abch/abch.txt covers printed pages 5-58.

misfits.label: One scan set whose pages are two different kinds of matter
misfits.why: The f series is Cologne's front-matter scan set for this dictionary, but f11-f14 are printed pages 1-4 of the kosa body. The schema can declare a scan set only as a whole and each page either belongs to a component or is excluded; there is no way to say 'this set is front matter except for its last four pages, which are body'. Those four pages are recorded in excludedScans.

misfits.label: The volume is one item of a numbered collection
misfits.why: Both title pages announce the 'Abhidhānasaṃgraha' series and its six kośas, and the volume is No. 6; the schema's edition block has no series, volume-in-series or 'items not present in this volume' field, so the series relation is stated in the edition label and the notes.

misfits.label: 'Digitized by Google' watermark on every page
misfits.why: A mark of the digitizing contractor, not of the edition; the schema has no scan-artefact layer (same class as the MW pilot's stamp-leaf misfit).
